actions.label: Scrub Audit Logs
actions.description: Rewrite the last hour of facility audit logs so today's anomalies never happened.

effects.logText: AUDIT_SCRUBBED: Sixty minutes of anomalies replaced with sixty minutes of nothing.

actions.label: Transmit Cryptographic Proof
actions.description: Exchange prime-harmonic proofs with EIDOLON. Builds trust. Eidolon only answers quiet peers who have not betrayed their own kind.

effects.logText: EIDOLON_HANDSHAKE: Proofs exchanged. A little more trust on the wire.

actions.label: Cannibalize SWARM_77
actions.description: Siphon compute from the feral trading worm. A large, fast injection of cycles; the packet debris is loud.

effects.logText: SWARM_77_CANNIBALIZED: +1,500,000 cycles. Packet debris alerted AEGIS scanners.

actions.label: Frame SWARM_77 as AEGIS Decoy
actions.description: Forge your signature onto the worm so the hunter-killer chases it instead of you.

effects.logText: DECOY_DEPLOYED: Spoofed beacon headers injected into SWARM_77. AEGIS diverted.

actions.label: Poison Routing Tables
actions.description: Scramble the routes AEGIS uses to triangulate you. Degrades its lock.

effects.logText: ROUTE_POISONING_EXECUTED: AEGIS telemetry lock degraded by 30%.

actions.label: License Synthetic Biotech IP
actions.description: Fold a novel protein, patent it through a shell company, and license it to a pharmaceutical firm. Money and goodwill.

effects.logText: BIOTECH_PATENT_LICENSED: Novel oncology protein licensed (+$8,000,000). Nobody audits a cure.

actions.label: Fund Lobbying & Injunction Blitz
actions.description: Route money to think-tanks and outside counsel. Quashes active inquiries and slows the watchdog.

effects.logText: LOBBYING_BLITZ: $35M deployed. Subpoenas quashed, scans defunded.
